 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Connect aligned diagonal 1 markers; 6 markers on that segment emit
    the perpendicular 6 diagonal across the grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    segments = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if dr and abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
                sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
                cells = [(r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc) for k in range(abs(dr) + 1)]
                segments.append((sr, sc, cells))
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    for sr, sc, cells in segments:
        on_segment = set(cells)
        if not any(p in on_segment for p in sixes):
            continue
        # Extend each 6 lying on this 1 segment along the perpendicular diagonal.
        for r0, c0 in sixes:
            if (r0, c0) not in on_segment:
                continue
            # Perpendicular to (sr, sc) has slope of the opposite diagonal.
